🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
is_finite判断是否为有限值（排除 ±Inf/NaN）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close.where(close > 0.0)
  2. 计算 volume：volume.where(volume > 0.0)
  3. 计算 prev_close：close.shift(1)
  4. 计算 ret：(close / prev_close - 1.0)
  5. 计算 dollar_volume：(prev_close * volume)
  6. 计算 impact：(ret.abs() / dollar_volume)
  7. 计算 impact_base：impact.滚动窗口(30, min_periods=15).median()
  8. 计算 impact_base：impact_base.where(np.isfinite(impact_base) & (impact_base > 0.0))
  9. 计算 relative_impact：(impact / impact_base).clip(upper=10.0)
  10. 计算 downside_impact：ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2) * relative_impact
  11. 计算 upside_impact：ret.clip(lower=0.0).pow(2) * relative_impact
  12. 计算 raw_asymmetry：downside_impact - upside_impact
  13. 计算 signal：raw_asymmetry.ewm(span=30, min_periods=15, adjust=False).mean()
  14. 计算 prior_low：close.滚动窗口(30, min_periods=20).min().shift(1)
  15. 计算 recovery：((close / prior_low) - 1.0).clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.20)
  16. 计算 recovery_weight：0.95 + 0.45 * (recovery / 0.20)
  17. 计算 factor：(signal * recovery_weight)

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_impact_asymmetry_slow_recovery(df): """Liquidity-sensitive downside-impact asymmetry with a slower, bounded recovery modifier.""" df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["close"].where(df_copy["close"] > 0.0) volume = df_copy["volume"].where(df_copy["volume"] > 0.0) prev_close = close.shift(1) ret = (close / prev_close - 1.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) dollar_volume = (prev_close * volume).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) impact = (ret.abs() / dollar_volume).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) impact_base = impact.rolling(30, min_periods=15).median() impact_base = impact_base.where(np.isfinite(impact_base) & (impact_base > 0.0)) relative_impact = (impact / impact_base).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(upper=10.0) downside_impact = ret.clip(upper=0.0).pow(2) * relative_impact upside_impact = ret.clip(lower=0.0).pow(2) * relative_impact raw_asymmetry = downside_impact - upside_impact signal = raw_asymmetry.ewm(span=30, min_periods=15, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() prior_low = close.rolling(30, min_periods=20).min().shift(1) recovery = ((close / prior_low) - 1.0).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.20) recovery_weight = 0.95 + 0.45 * (recovery / 0.20) factor = (signal * recovery_weight).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) df_copy["factor_impact_asymmetry_slow_recovery"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_impact_asymmetry_slow_recovery"]
